## SuperSubtitler 0.2.1 — settings that explain themselves

Download both files into one folder: `SuperSubtitlerGUI.exe` (the window) and `SuperSubtitler.exe` (the engine).

### ⚙️ Settings page
- Every setting now has a plain-words name, an explanation of what it does, the **recommended range** and its **default** — one click puts the default back.
- Values outside the recommendation are marked **yellow** (allowed, results may suffer); values SuperSubtitler would refuse are **red** and cannot be saved. Rules between values are checked too (e.g. shortest display time ≤ longest, no turbo model for translating).
- Fixed choices (device, models, number format, surround mode) are drop-downs instead of free text.
- Changing an expert value (the tested runtime) asks before saving.

### 🔧 Console tool
- New `-printdefaults` prints the documented default settings (the window shows them from there, so they can never drift apart).
- Stricter checks for three timing values that used to accept anything (`vad_speech_pad_ms`, `sub_min_gap_ms`, `sub_gap_split_ms`).

The exes are not code-signed; Windows SmartScreen may warn — "More info" → "Run anyway". Built by GitHub Actions.
